ov: بادي (الإنجليزية: Buddy) هو فلم رعب كوميدي أمريكي صدر عام 2026، أخرجه كاسبر كيلي عن سيناريو كتبه بالاشتراك مع جيمي كينغ. ويشارك في بطولته كريستين ميلوتي، وتوفر غريس، وكيغان-مايكل كي، ومايكل شانون، وباتن أوزوالت. عُرض الفلم لأول مرة ضمن قسم «منتصف الليل» في دورة عام 2026 من مهرجان صاندانس السينمائي في 22 يناير 2026، وتم طرحه في دور العرض بالولايات المتحدة في 28 أغسطس 2026، بواسطة رودسايد أتراكشنز وسابان فيلمز.
plotEn:
It's Buddy! is a 1990s-style children's television series hosted by the titular Buddy, an anthropomorphic talking orange unicorn with magical powers. Cast members include child actors Freddy, Wade, Josh, and Oliver; Buddy's co-host Betty Bunny; supporting adult characters Mailman Miles and Nurse Nancy; and sentient objects Mr. Mailbox, Couchy the Couch, Clocky the Clock, Strappy the Backpack, Lampy the Lamp, Trashy the Trash Can, and Charlie the Train.
Despite an increasingly angry Buddy's insistence, Josh refuses to participate in a dance party and mysteriously disappears. He is replaced with another child, Hannah, while Buddy assures everyone Josh is traveling to utopian Diamond City. When Freddy finds Josh's bloodstained book in the trash, she consults Nancy, who promises to talk to Buddy. Freddy and Wade later witnesses Buddy choking and bludgeoning Nancy to death before fatally punching Clocky off the wall.
Freddy and Wade convince Hannah and Oliver to escape to Diamond City inside Charlie, but Buddy rips Charlie's face off and takes Wade away. As Buddy approaches Freddy, Wade uses a cleaning spray and a lighter to burn and disfigure him. Buddy then stabs Mailman Miles to death. Freddy, Oliver, and Hannah escape with Strappy and Mr. Mailbox; the latter's mouth was torn off by Buddy after he had witnessed Buddy's killing of Josh. Freddy fails to save Wade, and Buddy impales him on his horn.
